AsyncOperationTracker.name: AsyncOperationTracker
AsyncOperationTracker.description: Represents the status of an asynchronous request initiated from the Quote, Order, and CreditMemo objects.

AsyncOperationNumber.description: A string that identifies the operation tracked in AsyncOperationTracker.

CorrelationIdentifier.description: A string that identifies an operation across services.

ExpiresAt.description: The timestamp indicating when this record will be deleted.

FailedJobItems.description: The number of items within the job that have failed.

FinishedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the asynchronous process completed.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user or group that owns the job.

ParentOperationId.description: This field is a relationship field.

ReferenceEntityId.description: Contains the ID of a record associated with the asynchronous request. For example, if the asynchronous request is associated with a credit memo, this field contains the ID of the credit memo.

StartedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when Salesforce started the asynchronous process.

Status.description: The status of the asynchronous request.

SubmittedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the asynchronous process was submitted by the REST request.

SuccessfulJobItems.description: The number of successful items in this job.

TotalJobItems.description: Total number of items in this job.

Request.description: The payload required to process the async request that’s populated by internal Salesforce services that use the async framework. This field is available in API version 66.0 and later.

Response.description: Stores the response for each step in the async flow, used in the next steps of the flow until its completion. This field is available in API version 66.0 and later.

SequenceNumber.description: The sequence number associated with each step of a multiple step job, to define the execution order for the async job flow. This field is available in API version 66.0 and later.
